description:
Accounting preparation for meshmakers GmbH — connect bank transactions with
accounting documents and analyze costs by category.

Installs:
- the Meshmakers.Accounting construction kit model (auto-imported from the
  catalog, pulls Basic + Basic.Accounting transitively)
- fiscal-year 2026 with 12 cost categories and 2 income categories
  (CategoryKind EXPENSE/INCOME, AB#4507)
- reporting root folders (Documents storage)
- the FinAPI adapter (octo-finapi-adapter Helm chart; configure the finAPI
  ClientId/ClientSecret in AdapterConfiguration per tenant)
- 13 pipelines: the six finAPI pipelines (account/transaction sync, bank
  connection import + BIC resolution, web-form create/complete) share ONE
  "FinAPI" DataFlow so they deploy together and appear as tabs in one
  execution-history dialog; the rest sit in their own DataFlows: Excel tree
  import, CSV transaction import, AI prompt, document upload (staging +
  duplicate check only), asynchronous document analysis (5-minute polling +
  on-demand via POST /processDocuments: OCR + AI extraction of staged
  uploads, replaces the former synchronous analysis and the Todo fallback —
  incomplete extractions stay visible on the UploadedDocument inbox
  entity), transaction matching
- the Microsoft 365 e-mail document import pipeline — ships DISABLED
  (System/Enabled=false); the meshmakers-app activates it from Settings ->
  E-Mail Import (writes the EmailImportSettings configuration, rewrites the
  trigger mailbox/folders and deploys the DataFlow)
- the MicrosoftGraphDocuments configuration (placeholder Azure app-registration
  credentials) used by the e-mail import via the Uses association
- the _trees repo-browser query
- the accounting SPA as an Application workload (meshmakers-app Helm
  chart), rolled out by the Communication Operator
- the meshmakers-app OIDC client (authorization code + PKCE, redirect
  ${octo.scheme}://accounting.${octo.domain}/) used by the deployed SPA
- the AnthropicAiConfig AiConfiguration (placeholder API key) referenced by
  the AI pipelines via apiKeyConfigurationName
- the FinApiConfiguration (placeholder credentials, live.finapi.io) that all
  finAPI pipelines load via GetPipelineConfigByWellKnownName + Uses association

PREREQUISITES: communication and reporting must be enabled on the target
tenant. The service-managed System.Communication blueprint seeds the Pool
(670000000000000000000001) and Mesh Adapter (670000000000000000000002)
this seed associates to.

Post-install:
- DeployDataFlow per DataFlow + DeployWorkload for the app (operator pools)
- Set the real Anthropic API key on the AnthropicAiConfig configuration and
  the finAPI credentials on FinApiConfiguration — every blueprint re-apply
  resets both to the placeholders (scripts/om_set_secrets.ps1 restores them
  from the gitignored scripts/secrets.local.json)
- The two ToDo-notification pipelines (Notify ToDo / Notify ToDo Inbound)
  ship DISABLED with a TODO_SET_NOTIFICATION_MAILBOX placeholder (AB#4934 —
  the mailbox is tenant-specific; earlier seeds hardcoded the meshmakers
  mailbox, so every tenant polled a foreign mailbox). Set the mailbox in
  both pipeline definitions, fill MicrosoftGraphDocuments, then enable +
  DeployDataFlow. Every re-apply resets them to this shipped state.
- The Microsoft 365 e-mail import ships disabled — activate it in the
  meshmakers-app under Settings -> E-Mail Import after filling the Azure
  app-registration secrets on MicrosoftGraphDocuments via
  scripts/om_set_secrets.ps1 (microsoftGraph section). Every blueprint
  re-apply resets those to placeholders (same as Anthropic/finAPI).
- The remaining optional IMAP-email/Teams/Signal import pipelines still live
  in the repo's data/ folder — they carry tenant-specific secrets and are
  imported manually
